description: Make objects or text 3D with a live effect (Effect > 3D and Materials): extrude, revolve, inflate, or rotate (a flat plane turned in 3D). It stays editable in the 3D and Materials panel unless expand is true. The current effect takes depth, cap, revolveAngle, bothSides and wireframe; lighting, materials and rotation stay at the menu command's defaults (Off-Axis Front). With classic: true it applies Effect > 3D (Classic) instead, which also takes rotation angles, perspective and a surface style

cap.description: Extrude and revolve: cap on, solid (true, default) or off, hollow

classic.description: Use the classic effect (extrude, revolve, rotate). Default false

depth.description: Extrude or inflate depth in points. Default 50 (extrude), 10 (inflate)

expand.description: Expand the result to plain artwork (Object > Expand Appearance). Default false

perspective.description: Classic only: perspective angle in degrees. Default 0

rotation.description: Classic only: rotation in degrees (-180 to 180). Default x -18, y -26, z 8 (Off-Axis Front)

surface.description: Classic only. Default plastic (diffuse for rotate)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: apply_3d_effect
title: Apply 3d Effect
